name: Can I finance a garage-to-ADU conversion, and what options are available?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance a garage-to-ADU conversion, and what options are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are several financing options available for garage-to-ADU conversions. Common options include home equity loans, home equity lines of credit (HELOCs), cash-out refinances, and construction loans. Some government programs or local initiatives may also offer financing incentives for ADU development. It's advisable to consult with a financial advisor to determine the best option for your specific situation and financial goals.
